scope: Implement versioned adapter contract and Conventional mapping, repair concrete local runtime blocker and complete normal Conventional project work with independent evaluation; Markitect mapping later

freshConventionalTrajectories.countIncludes: Failed requests, main actors, native helpers and fresh independent final assessors across both trajectories
freshConventionalTrajectories.first: Fresh normal Conventional case through all declared stations; no Markitect dependency
freshConventionalTrajectories.second: Only after specific first-run defect or a completed first case, fresh source/config/input-bound followup; never replay or repeat unchanged runtime failure

startCondition: Coherent clean privately backed-up source, relevant mechanical checks, exact existing executable/config/public inputs/setup and own session binding; report actual start receipt, no separate blanket approval phase

stopCondition: Same unchanged native setup failure or unresolved owned process/turn exposure is terminal; report concrete blocker before additional actual execution. No automatic resource refill.
notAuthorized: Product code imports or Markitect simulation
priorEvidence: All failed pilots and receipts preserved; development tests are not study or method superiority evidence
